    • calculateZoomLevels

      public static int calculateZoomLevels(int width, int height, int tileSize)
      Calculates the optimal number of zoom levels based on image and tile dimensions. The number of levels is determined by how many times the longest side of the image can be halved until it is smaller than or equal to the tile size.
      Parameters:
      width - The width of the image.
      height - The height of the image.
      tileSize - The size of one side of a square tile.
      Returns:
      The calculated number of zoom levels.
